en.hubeali: H 14494 – Muhammad, from Ahmad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel Bin Saaleh, from Zareeh who said:

‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws seeking refuge for one of hisasws sons and heasws was saying: ‘Iasws am resolved against you, O wind, and O pain, whatever creature you are, with the determination which Aliasws Bin Abu Talibasws and the Messengersaww of Allahazwj held against the Jinn in the valley of Al-Sabrah. en.sarwar: 46. Muhammad, from Ahmad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel Bin Saaleh, from Zareeh who said:

‘I heard Abu Abdullah (a.s.) seeking refuge for one of his (a.s.) sons and he (a.s.) was saying: ‘I (a.s.) am resolved against you, O wind, and O pain, whatever creature you are, with the determination which Ali (a.s.) Bin Abu Talib (a.s.) and the Messenger (saww) of Allah (azwj) held against the Jinn in the valley of Al-Sabrah. So they answered, and they obeyed. You answer and obey, and go away from my (a.s.) son so and so, so of my (a.s.) daughter so and so, at this very moment, at this very moment’.
